summary: Executed backend pytest regression and frontend Playwright e2e for dashboard analysis, reports/detail tabs, settings, integrations, and health/settings stability. Core flows are working end-to-end.

critical.issue: Blocking network I/O via synchronous requests.get/requests.post is used inside async FastAPI handlers, which can degrade concurrency and cause latency spikes/timeouts under load.

issues: One interactive anchor ('Made with Emergent') is missing data-testid; all app-owned critical controls tested had data-testid.

action_items: Replace synchronous requests usage in async backend endpoints with async HTTP client (e.g., httpx.AsyncClient) to prevent event-loop blocking.
Optionally add data-testid to the footer external link if strict universal selector policy is required.
critical_code_review_comments: Async FastAPI routes currently perform blocking external calls; this is the main reliability/scalability risk found.
No hardcoded backend URL found in frontend API service; env-based API base URL usage is correct.
seed_data_creation: Created test reports/events via API during regression (analysis reports and integration events).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite is available at /app/backend/tests/test_api_regression.py and currently passes (5/5). Frontend end-to-end smoke/regression on public URL passed for all requested user flows. Focus next on non-functional backend concurrency risk from sync requests inside async handlers.
rca of the issue: RCA: /api/health and /api/analyze call external Ollama endpoints using requests in async route context. Repro: run concurrent requests to these endpoints while Ollama is slow/unreachable; event loop gets blocked, reducing throughput and increasing response time. Mitigation: migrate to async HTTP client and/or move LLM call to background worker with timeout/circuit breaker.
